question: What is IBM Cloud Pak for Data?

answers:
The IBM Cloud Pak for Data is a Kubernetes-based container platform that helps organizations modernize and automate their application workloads. It allows for development and deployment on your own infrastructure, reducing risks and vulnerabilities.
In today’s market, enterprises must offer robust digital products, which often involves complex integrations. The IBM Cloud Pak for Integration provides a streamlined solution to this challenge, allowing for process modernization and future innovation.
Once installed, IBM Cloud Pak for Integration simplifies monitoring, maintenance, and upgrades, helping enterprises stay ahead.
You can collect, organize, and analyze data using a comprehensive platform for governance, analytics, and AI on Red Hat OpenShift on IBM Cloud. With IBM Cloud Pak for Data, accessing trusted data is easy, empowering you to make data-driven decisions and operationalize AI with transparency.

history.content: Does the IBM Watson Speech-to-Text service support various audio formats?

Yes, the IBM Watson Speech-to-Text service supports various audio formats like audio/alaw;rate={rate}. For more information about the supported audio formats, you can refer to the following topics:
- [Audio terminology and characteristics](https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/speech-to-text?topic=speech-to-text-audio-terminology)
- [Supported audio formats](https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/speech-to-text?topic=speech-to-text-audio-formats)
The service accommodates many audio formats (MIME types), including those that support compression. This feature allows you to maximize the amount of audio data you can send with a request. Different formats may support varying sampling rates and other characteristics.

The IBM Watson® Speech to Text service can extract speech from audio in many formats. The installable IBM Watson® Speech to Text service provides an [API](https://www.ibm.com/watson/developercloud/speech-to-text/api/v1/curl.html) that uses IBM's speech-recognition capabilities to produce transcripts of spoken audio.
Does it support previous-generation and next-generation languages?

Yes. The Speech to Text service supports both previous-generation and next-generation languages and models. The IBM Watson® Speech to Text service features a continuously expanding collection of advanced models that enhance the speech recognition capabilities compared to previous-generation models. Each model specifies the language of the spoken audio and the sampling rate.

The Text to Speech service has the following known limitations. These issues apply to service functionality that spans releases on all platforms. For information about known limitations specific to Text to Speech for IBM Cloud Pak for Data version 4.6.x, see Limitations and known issues in Watson Speech services. effective July 31,
2023, all previous-generation models will be removed from the service and the documentation. Users must migrate to the equivalent next-generation model by this date.
For more detailed information about the service's limitations, you can refer to the following topics:
- [Quotas and Limits](https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/speech-to-text?topic=speech-to-text-quotas)
- [Regional service availability](https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/speech-to-text?topic=speech-to-text-regions)
- [Migrating to next-generation models](https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/speech-to-text?topic=speech-to-text-models-migrate)
I do not have any additional information.
Where can I find information about releases and updates?

You can find information about releases and updates for the IBM Watson Speech to Text service in the following resources:
- [IBM Cloud release notes](https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/release-notes?topic=release-notes#release-notes-speech-to-text): Provides information about new features, improvements, and known issues in each release.
- [IBM Cloud Pak for Data release notes](https://www.ibm.com/support/pages/node/1294440): Contains release notes for IBM Cloud Pak for Data, which includes the Watson Speech to Text service.
- [IBM Watson Developer Blog](https://developer.ibm.com/watson/blog/): Shares news, announcements, and updates related to IBM Watson services, including Speech to Text.
- [IBM Watson Speech to Text GitHub repository](https://github.com/watson-developer-cloud/speech-to-text-nodejs): Shares sample code, tutorials, and community contributions for the Watson Speech to Text service.
These resources will help you stay informed about the latest updates and changes to the IBM Watson Speech to Text service.
